data.turoyo: Alyas ʕAntar: Ḥasab ma ḥa xəd kobəʕ kibe mfasarre.
data.translation: Alyas Antar: According to how each person wants, he can interpret them.

rationale: Third actual II Infectum example: each person interprets an anaphoric plural object as desired; preserve s spelling and the supplied unresolved them. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; interpretation rests on the Turoyo.
